initial:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D sprite animation sheet, transparent PNG, for a pixel art fantasy shop game.
Input image 1: character DESIGN reference. Use ONLY the silver-haired violet-hatted apprentice mage in the TOP LEFT of this reference. Keep her EXACT identity, hat shape with brass buckle and two stars, short violet cape, silver bob haircut, brown shoulder satchel, cream tunic, dark boots, and warm pixel art palette. Do not include the other five people.
Generate EXACTLY EIGHT full-body frames of this SAME mage in a strict FOUR COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS uniform grid, ideally canvas 2048x1024, eight square equal cells. Each cell has the SAME character scale and stable registration: body center x at 50% of each cell, fixed boot contact baseline at 88% cell height, hat top at 10% cell height, no part extends past 10%-90% cell bounds. Consistent side bag, head size, hair and outfit in all frames. Face three-quarter toward LEFT in EVERY frame. Pixel-art sprite consistency is crucial, crisp logical pixel clusters, no smooth anime illustration, no sketch strokes, no extra motion blur.
Genuine alpha TRANSPARENT background outside each sprite. No painted checkerboard, no shadows between cells, no sheet dividers, no floor, no labels or numbering or text.
Exact row-major frame order:
0 top left: WALK CONTACT A, left boot clearly extended forward toward left, right leg back, right arm naturally forward, cape trails slightly right.
1 top second: WALK PASSING A, legs passing under body, left boot planted, right knee visibly bent and raised, bag settles close, no shift of head location.
2 top third: WALK CONTACT B, opposite leg: right boot clearly extended forward toward left, left leg back, left arm forward, opposite cape swing. Must look visibly different from frame0.
3 top fourth: WALK PASSING B, right boot planted, left knee raised, opposite passing pose from frame1.
4 bottom left: IDLE, feet together, calm open eyes, hands relaxed in front, watching merchandise.
5 bottom second: IDLE BLINK, same exact standing pose as frame4, eyelids closed, minimal change from4.
6 bottom third: PURCHASE SUCCESS, delighted smile and sparkling open eyes, a tiny tied green herb bundle held happily near chest, small appreciative raised hand. Same overall body bounding box, not jumping.
7 bottom fourth: PURCHASE DISAPPOINTMENT, small downturned mouth, drooping shoulders, empty hands, gaze slightly down, no added tear icons.
No duplicate walk legs! All four walk frames must articulate alternating knee and boot positions so this loops as a real walking gait. Keep camera, silhouette scale and baseline uniform so animation will not pop. No backgrounds or other characters.
refinement: Edit target: the supplied 8-frame sprite atlas. Preserve its EXACT canvas dimensions, strict four columns and two rows, alpha transparency, silver-haired purple mage identity, pixel-art rendering, hat size, and ALL FOUR BOTTOM ROW FRAMES exactly unchanged. Fix ONLY the FOUR WALK FRAMES in the TOP ROW for animation continuity. Her brown satchel must remain attached to her RIGHT HIP on the VIEWER'S LEFT in ALL FOUR frames, at the same horizontal position, like bottom-row idle frame; it MUST NOT swap sides in alternating frames. Keep the head, torso and hat registered at identical positions in each cell. Animate the BOOTS with a clear alternating leg cycle: frame0 left leg forward/right leg back, frame1 right knee up passing planted left leg, frame2 right leg forward/left leg back, frame3 left knee up passing planted right leg. Frames0 and2 need opposite knees/boots, not duplicates. Short cloak sways subtly but does not change length. All top-row characters face the same direction, no mirror flips, same size, same baseline, no change to other cells. Retain genuine transparent PNG, no background, no text.
